modern: Mind meets power. Forceful, penetrating communication; words that can heal or wound and tend to be remembered. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.body: One private conversation changes who is trusted with the plan. Mercury conjunct Pluto can bring missing money, withheld information, or an undisclosed agreement into the same moment as the decision about what happens next. Once the hidden arrangement is named, access and loyalty are no longer abstract questions. Preserve the record before the conversation gets rewritten afterward. Ask who knew, who approved, and who had something to gain from keeping the information private.
